title: A customer can be saved with nobody as its sales representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a customer for this test with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the Sales Representative field reading "Unassigned".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The customer saves with nobody in the field.
  • Its page shows "Sales Representative" reading "Unassigned".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R2: “The field is optional. A customer can be saved with nobody in it.”
  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 2 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases.
